description: Which prompts count as blank: nothing but whitespace is left of them once their control and invisible characters are stripped. The daemon's refusal of such a scheduled task's prompt (session/term/mod.rs, is_blank_once_stripped) and the window's check before it saves one (packages/ui/src/scheduledTasks/blankPrompt.ts, isBlankPrompt) both read every case, so that the two copies of the rule stay in step. `text` is JSON, so its characters are written as escapes.

cases.name: spaces, tabs and line breaks are blank
no-break and ideographic spaces are whitespace
control characters are stripped, the C1 next-line among them
bidirectional marks and isolates are stripped
formatting fillers and selectors are stripped
line and paragraph separators are blank
characters outside the basic plane are stripped
whitespace mixed with invisible characters is blank
a letter among invisible characters is not blank
a blank-looking character that is not whitespace is not blank
the object replacement character is not blank
an emoji joined by an invisible joiner is not blank
